title: Targeting FoxO1-STX17-mediated autophagic flux: Quercetin's therapeutic mechanism in diabetic nephropathy.
authors: Hou, Baoluo; Li, Yachun; Tang, Jingyi; Cao, Xiaoxue; Zhang, Shujiao; Cai, Yuzi; Guo, Jing; Xi, Junyu; Wang, Dongyi; Liu, Wei Jing; Lu, Hongmei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素通过FoxO1-STX17通路改善糖尿病肾病自噬流，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白/自噬机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Diabetic nephropathy (DN) involves autophagic stress from defective lysosomal clearance. Quercetin, a flavonol, shows therapeutic potential but its mechanism remains unclear. OBJECTIVE: Investigate quercetin's role in DN via FoxO1-STX17-mediated autophagosome-lysosome fusion. METHODS: DN was induced in C57BL/6J mice (uninephrectomy + streptozotocin [50 mg/kg]). Quercetin (150 mg/kg/day) or valsartan (40 mg/kg/day) was administered for 12 weeks. Renal function, histopathology, and autophagy markers (p62, LC3-II, STX17) were evaluated. Quercetin metabolites were identified via UPLC-HRMS. Network pharmacology, molecular docking, dynamics (MD), and biolayer interferometry (BLI) validated targets. Advanced glycation end products (AGE) (100 mug/mL)-stimulated podocytes, Bafilomycin (Baf)-A1-treated and FoxO1-silenced podocytes were used for mechanistic validation. RESULTS: In vivo, quercetin ameliorated renal injury and restored autophagic flux without affecting upstream autophagy initiation. Ten quercetin-derived metabolites were identified in serum. Bioinformatics analysis nominated FoxO1 as a key regulator of quercetin-modulated autophagy. In vitro, quercetin protected podocytes and promoted autophagosome-lysosome fusion, effects that were reversed by Baf-A1 and replicated in FoxO1-silenced cells. CONCLUSION: Quercetin alleviates DN by targeting FoxO1 to restore STX17-dependent autophagosome-lysosome fusion, thereby resolving autophagic stress. These findings support quercetin as a promising therapeutic candidate for DN.
abstract_zh: 背景：糖尿病肾病（DN）涉及由溶酶体清除缺陷引起的自噬应激。槲皮素（一种黄酮醇）显示出治疗潜力，但其机制尚不明确。目的：通过FoxO1-STX17介导的自噬体-溶酶体融合，研究槲皮素在DN中的作用。方法：在C57BL/6J小鼠中诱导DN（单侧肾切除+链脲佐菌素[50 mg/kg]）。给予槲皮素（150 mg/kg/天）或缬沙坦（40 mg/kg/天）治疗12周。评估肾功能、组织病理学和自噬标志物（p62、LC3-II、STX17）。通过UPLC-HRMS鉴定槲皮素代谢物。网络药理学、分子对接、动力学（MD）和生物层干涉法（BLI）验证靶点。使用晚期糖基化终产物（AGE）（100 μg/mL）刺激的足细胞、巴弗洛霉素（Baf）-A1处理和FoxO1沉默的足细胞进行机制验证。结果：在体内，槲皮素改善肾损伤并恢复自噬流，而不影响上游自噬起始。在血清中鉴定出十种槲皮素衍生代谢物。生物信息学分析提名FoxO1为槲皮素调节自噬的关键调控因子。在体外，槲皮素保护足细胞并促进自噬体-溶酶体融合，这些效应被Baf-A1逆转，并在FoxO1沉默细胞中复制。结论：槲皮素通过靶向FoxO1恢复STX17依赖性自噬体-溶酶体融合，从而缓解自噬应激，减轻DN。这些发现支持槲皮素作为DN的有前景的治疗候选药物。
